name: WdInsertCells
description: Specifies where and what type of cells to add to an existing table.

constants.name: wdInsertCellsShiftRight
constants.description: Insert new cells to the left of the selected cells.

constants.name: wdInsertCellsShiftDown
constants.description: Inserts new cells above the selected cells.

constants.name: wdInsertCellsEntireRow
constants.description: Inserts an entire row above the row that contains the selection.

constants.name: wdInsertCellsEntireColumn
constants.description: Inserts an entire column to the left of the column that contains the selection.
